'''Nu Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] squadron that fought in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was present at the [[Defense of Outpost D-34|First Battle of Javin]].
